raleigh.destination_info: Raleigh’s relatively moderate temperatures make it a year-round destination. Summers (Jun–Aug) are generally hot and humid. The North Carolina State Fair (Oct) offers rides, music and a flower and garden show. Winters (Dec–Feb) bring colder temperatures with the possibility of snow and sleet.

columbus.destination_info: Columbus is a year-round destination with a temperate climate. The Columbus Winter Beerfest (Jan) features more than 100 breweries. Artists from around the country exhibit their work on the Scioto Mile for the Columbus Arts Festival (Jun). The Columbus Pride Festival (Jun) includes a downtown parade, live music and vendors. The Ohio State Fair (Jul–Aug) offers agricultural exhibitions, live music and rides.

san-antonio.destination_info: San Antonio has mild winters (Dec–Feb), and hot and humid summers (Jun–Sep). Summer, as well as warm spring (Mar–May) are the most popular times to visit. Remember the Alamo Weekend (Mar) sees reenactments of the battle. Fiesta San Antonio (Apr), a long-standing heritage festival, is a huge, 11-day party known for its flower parades, live music and food stands.

ontario.destination_info: Ontario is a year-round destination, with mild to warm weather for much of the year. Summers (Jun–Aug) tend to be hot, while winters (Dec–Feb) are typically mild. There is a slightly higher chance of rain Jan–Apr. The Road to California (Jan) is a quilt show featuring quilting competitions, classes and exhibits. The city celebrates Independence Day (Jul 4) with a parade, picnic and fireworks display. The Route 66 Cruisin' Reunion (Sep) attracts vintage cars from around the country.

cincinnati.destination_info: Apr–Sep is a popular time to visit, peaking at the height of the hot summer (Jul–Aug). Temperatures can dip below freezing in winter (Dec–Feb). Big-name jazz, R&B and soul artists headline the Cincinnati Music Festival (Jul). Riverfest (Sep) features a fireworks display, along with live music and food stalls.

jacksonville.destination_info: Jacksonville is mild to warm most of the year, with hot and humid summers (Jun–Aug). Popular times to visit include Mar–Jul and Nov–Dec. The Jacksonville Jazz Festival (May) features free concerts by prominent international jazz artists in various indoor and outdoor venues.

west-palm-beach.destination_info: West Palm Beach has a tropical, sunny climate. Mar–May is a popular time to visit, especially during college spring break (Mar/Apr). Hurricane season typically runs Jun–Nov. SunFest (Apr/May) is a music festival along the waterfront, featuring bands across several stages. The city's main thoroughfare comes to life with concerts and food stalls every Thursday night year-round, as part of Clematis by Night.

atlanta.destination_info: Atlanta is a year-round destination, though most visitors arrive in summer (May–Sep). Winters (Nov–Mar) are generally mild. Big events include celebrations for Martin Luther King, Jr., Weekend (Jan) and Independence Day (Jul 4). The Yellow Daisy Festival (Sep), an arts and crafts fair, is held in nearby Stone Mountain.

los-angeles.destination_info: Los Angeles is a year-round destination. The weather's mostly warm and mild, with hotter temperatures Jul–Oct. Arts and cultural events happen regularly, including film festivals such as LA Film Fest (Jun) and AFI Fest (Nov). In summer, there are free outdoor concerts and film screenings at venues across the city. Other major annual events include the Academy Awards (Feb/Mar) and the LA Marathon (Feb/Mar).

chicago.destination_info: Chicago's peak season is Jun–Aug. Popular events throughout year include St. Patrick's Day, when the river is tinted green (Mar 17); the Pride Parade (Jun); the Taste of Chicago culinary festival (Jul) and the Jazz Festival (Sep). During the holiday season (Nov–Dec), the Magnificent Mile Lights Festival and Christkindlmarket, a German Christmas market in Daley Plaza, draw crowds to the city.

dallas.destination_info: Weather in Dallas is warm Mar–May and Sep–Oct and hot in summer (Jun–Aug). Winters (Nov–Feb) are cool to cold. Visitor traffic is steady year-round, but crowds are heaviest during the State Fair of Texas (late Sep–mid Oct), a huge, 24-day event that attracts millions with its rides, auto show and food vendors galore. In Jan, the Cotton Bowl Classic, a historic college football game, is played at AT&T Stadium.

denver.destination_info: Denver’s mild summer months (Jun–Aug) are a popular time for visitors exploring the city and nearby national parks. The ski season runs through winter (Nov–Mar). Major events include the National Western Stock Show & Rodeo (Jan) and A Taste of Colorado (Sep) food and arts festival.

new-york.destination_info: NYC is a year-round destination, with iconic events like U.S. Open tennis (Aug–Sep) and Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade (Nov). Spring and fall have mild weather and strong performing-arts seasons. In summer, there's free, outdoor cultural events. On summer weekends, many New Yorkers leave town, making it a good time to score reservations at popular restaurants. Dec brings the Rockefeller Center tree lighting (varies, Nov/Dec) and Times Square's New Year's Eve party (Dec 31). Jan–Mar is cold, with an easier chance of getting Broadway tickets.

san-francisco.destination_info: Apr–Dec is when most people visit San Francisco, with crowds peaking in summer. Although average temperatures are higher then, mornings and evenings often have damp, chilly fog. In summer, street fairs and cultural institutions offer free outdoor entertainment. Winter visitors will find the opera and ballet seasons in full swing. Major annual events include Chinese New Year (Feb), Bay to Breakers footrace (May), San Francisco Pride parade and festival (Jun), and San Francisco Fleet Week (Oct).

seattle.destination_info: Most visitors come May–Sep, a period encompassing events such as the Seattle International Film Festival (May); Seafair (Jul), a summer festival including boat races, marathons and parades; and Bumbershoot (Sep), an international music and arts festival. Rainy season is Nov–May, though rain is possible year-round.

las-vegas.destination_info: Las Vegas is a busy year-round destination with a subtropical desert climate. There's no specific peak season, but crowds and prices increase around holidays and the many annual conventions. Popular events include the Consumer Electronic Show (Jan), the Project fashion trade show (Feb and Aug), NASCAR Weekend (Mar), the National Finals Rodeo (Dec), and New Year's Eve. During summer (Jun–Aug), extremely high daytime temperatures may make outdoor activities like golf and canyon hiking inadvisable.

orlando.destination_info: Orlando is busy year-round due to its theme parks and consistently warm, sunny weather. Peak season is during U.S. spring break weeks (Mar–Apr). Other especially popular times are Jun–Aug and Nov–Dec. Summers can be quite hot and humid. Along with the Florida Film Festival (Apr), Epcot's annual flower festival (Mar–May) and food festival (Sep–Nov) attract visitors.

charlotte.destination_info: Many travelers choose to visit in summer (May–Sep), when the weather's warm and often humid. Summer rainstorms are common. The Queen's Cup Steeplechase (Apr) is a popular horserace staged at Mineral Springs. The NASCAR Sprint All-Star Race (May) is a major date in the auto-sports calendar. Winter (Dec–Feb) is cool.

phoenix.destination_info: Most visitors arrive Dec–May, when the weather is warm and dry. Summers (May–Sep) are very hot. Local events include the Phoenix Open professional golf tournament (late Jan–early Feb), the Arizona State Fair (Oct) and the Arizona National Livestock Show (Dec).

miami.destination_info: With its subtropical climate and many beaches, Miami is a year-round destination. Peak season is Jan–Apr. Rains are heaviest during hurricane season (Jun–Nov), but showers, often brief, can occur at any time. Celebrities and the contemporary art world come for Art Basel Miami Beach and its numerous satellite art fairs and events (early Dec), and Food Network chefs are the draws at the South Beach Wine & Food Festival (Feb).

houston.destination_info: Most visitors explore Houston May–Aug when the days are hot and humid. Winters (Nov–Feb) tend to be mild. Local events include the Martin Luther King, Jr., Grande Parade (Jan) and the Houston Livestock Show & Rodeo (Mar).

boston.destination_info: Boston is a year-round destination with a 4-season climate. Spring and fall feature generally mild weather, although snow sometimes falls in early spring (Apr). Summer can be humid. Foliage season (mid-Sep–Nov) attracts the largest crowds. Patriots Day (3rd Mon of Apr) commemorates the start of the Revolutionary War and coincides with the famed Boston Marathon. Summer festivals include Boston Harborfest, the city’s weeklong 4th of July party, and Italian-American celebrations in the North End (late Jul–Aug).

minneapolis.destination_info: Peak travel is summer (May–Sep), when the weather's warm. Grand Old Days (St. Paul, Jun) is a street festival with a parade, live music and food stands. Aquatennial (Jul), an annual celebration of the city's lakes and rivers, includes family-friendly events and a fireworks display. Winter (Dec–Feb) is frequently snowy. Overnight temperatures fall well below freezing. The City of Lakes Loppet (Feb) is an urban cross-country skiing festival, with races and participation.

fort-lauderdale.destination_info: Most visitors arrive Dec–May, when the weather is warm and mostly dry. Summers (Jun–Sep) are hot and humid. Hurricanes are possible Jun–Nov. Local events include the A1A Marathon (Feb) and the International Boat Show (Nov).

detroit.destination_info: Detroit has 4 distinct seasons, with many travelers choosing to visit during the warm summer (Jun–Aug). Winters (Dec–Feb) are cold and snowy. Annual events include the North American International Auto Show (Jan), showcasing new cars and automotive technologies, and the dance-centric Movement Electronic Music Festival (May). The Detroit Jazz Festival (Sep) brings prominent international musicians to Hart Plaza for free shows.

philadelphia.destination_info: Philadelphia's peak travel season is May–Aug. Big events include the New Year's Day Mummers Parade, with costumes and bands; the Philadelphia Flower Show (Mar), a renowned horticultural event founded in 1829; the Welcome America festival, which features concerts and fireworks (Jun–Jul); the multi-week Fringe Festival (Sep), with dance, theater and music performances throughout the city; and the Philadelphia Marathon (Nov).

baltimore.destination_info: Baltimore has a 4-season climate with warm, humid summers (Jun–Sep) and some snow in winter (Dec–Feb). Most people choose to visit May–Sep. Artscape (Jul) is a 3-day major annual festival, with performing arts, free concerts and exhibitions. Free Fall (Oct) features a monthlong program of admission-free cultural events.

salt-lake-city.destination_info: Many choose to visit in summer (Jun–Sep), which has warm to hot days and mild evenings. Dec–Mar is cool to cold, coinciding with ski season at nearby resorts such as Park City. Notable annual events include the Mormon Tabernacle Choir's Christmas concert (3 days in Dec) and the Utah Arts Festival (Jun), which features an outdoor art show and a range of live performances in downtown's Library Square.

washington.destination_info: Most visitors arrive in summer (Jun–Sep) when the weather is mild and mostly dry. Winter through spring (Nov–May) tends to be cool and rainy. Local events include the Skagit Valley Tulip Festival (Apr), Seattle International Film Festival (May–Jun) and Bumbershoot (Sep), a music and arts festival held in Seattle.

san-diego.destination_info: Jun–Aug is when most people visit San Diego, where the weather's temperate year-round. Beaches are less crowded Dec–Feb, which bring cooler temperatures but brighter sun. Whale-watching season is from mid-Dec–mid-Mar. Major annual events include Comic-Con International (Jul), a massive comic book convention with workshops and film screenings. Fleet Week (autumn) is a large military appreciation event featuring Navy ship tours, an air show and more.

tampa.destination_info: Tampa has mild winters (Dec–Feb) and hot, rainy summers (Jun–Sep). Popular months for visitors are Mar, Jun–Jul and Dec. The city's signature event is the Gasparilla Pirate Festival (Jan/Feb), featuring an elaborate mock pirate invasion from the sea and a raucous parade downtown. In Feb, the Florida State Fair attracts families with carnival rides and attractions, livestock exhibitions and food stalls.

honolulu.destination_info: Peak periods include mid-Dec–Aug, particularly late Dec, U.S. schools’ spring break (Mar/Apr) and Japan’s Golden Week (late-Apr–early May). Temperatures are warm year-round and there are 2 main seasons: dry (Apr–Oct) and rainy (Nov–Mar), which is better for surfing and whale-watching. Key events include Kamehameha Day (Jun) and the Aloha Festivals (Sep), featuring traditional music, dance and crafts, and the Honolulu Marathon (Dec).

austin.destination_info: Austin has mild winters and very hot, humid summers that make some outdoor activities inadvisable. Most visitors arrive Mar–Sep. Spring sees crowds for the South by Southwest (SXSW) music and film festival (Mar) and the blooming of the bluebonnet (mid-Mar–mid Apr), which is the Texas state flower. Hotels are especially crowded during college graduation weekends (May). Fall's popular events are the Austin City Limits music festival (Sep), college football season (Sep–Nov) and the Austin Film Festival (Oct).

st-louis.destination_info: Apr–Sep is the most popular time to visit, coinciding with hot, humid summer and events like Fair St. Louis, a huge Fourth of July festival at Forest Park, and the Taste of St. Louis food festival (Sep). Weather in winter is cold, with occasional snow.

nashville.destination_info: Nashville is a year-round destination, though most visitors arrive May–Aug. Summers (Jun–Sep) are hot and humid, while winters (Nov–Mar) are cool, with light snow. Severe thunderstorms and tornadoes are possible Feb–May. Local events include Awesome April (bringing together fashion, music and film festivals), the Country Music Association Music Festival (Jun), and the Birthday of the Grand Ole Opry (Oct).

portland.destination_info: Portland has a humid continental climate. Spanning the warmest and sunniest months, May–Sep is a popular time to visit. Major draws include the waterfront, museums and historic landmarks. In the bay, there are schooner trips and sea kayaking rentals. Key events include the family-friendly Old Port Festival (Jun) and the Tall Ships parade (Jun/Jul). In the fall, there’s the Harvest on the Harbor food festival (Oct), the Maine Marathon (Oct) and the Maine Brewers Festival (Nov). The winter (Dec–Mar) is cold and snowy.

san-jose.destination_info: San Jose has a temperate climate with cool winters (Dec–Feb), and hot, dry summers (Jun–Sep) when most people visit. The San Jose Jazz Summer Fest (Aug) features concerts across a wide range of genres, including classic jazz, Latin and world music.

oakland.destination_info: Oakland is a year-round destination with a mild climate. Popular times to visit include the warmest months (May–Oct). Jack London Square is the site of many city events, including a weekly farmers’ market (Sun). Art + Soul Oakland (Aug) sees art, dance, music and kids’ events, plus food and craft vendors. The Eat Real Festival (Sep) offers cooking demonstrations, street food and live music in Jack London Square.

cleveland.destination_info: Peak travel is May–Sep, when the weather's warm and humid. Brite Winter (Feb) is an eclectic, multivenue music and art festival staged outdoors. Parade the Circle (Jun) is a colorful costumed parade. Taste of Tremont (Jul) is a hip neighborhood festival showcasing local food and drink. The Cleveland Irish Cultural Festival (Jul) celebrates Celtic heritage with food and drink, music and Irish dance. There are citywide craft beer and brewing events during Cleveland Beer Week (Oct). Winter (Dec–Feb) is cold and snowy.

sacramento.destination_info: The hot, dry, sunny summer months (May–Sep) are popular with visitors. Staged mostly in venues around Old Sacramento, the Sacramento Music Festival (May) focuses on jazz and blues. Sacramento Pride (Jun) is the city's main LGBT festival, and incorporates a parade, music and diverse market vendors. The California State Fair (Jul) features pop music concerts, exhibitions and a fairground. Winter (Dec–Feb) is mild with regular rainfall.

pittsburgh.destination_info: Pittsburgh has a continental climate with distinct seasons. May–Oct, a popular time to visit, is generally warm and humid. In contrast, the winter (Dec–Feb) is cold and snowy. Key events include the St. Patrick's Day Parade (Mar). The Three Rivers Arts Festival (Jun) offers free concerts and exhibits. The Vintage Grand Prix (Jul) features classic automobiles. The Dirty Dozen (Nov) is a bike race on the city’s steepest hills. Light Up Night (Nov), with illuminations and fireworks, kicks off the winter shopping season.

kansas-city.destination_info: Peak travel is summer (May–Aug), when the weather's generally warm and humid with occasional rainstorms. May is the most common month for tornadoes. The Big 12 Men's Basketball Championship (Mar) is a major date in the NCAA calendar. Teams compete to show off the best of Kansas City's signature cuisine at the American Royal World Series of Barbecue (Oct). The shopping district is illuminated for the holiday season during Plaza Lights (Nov–Jan). Winter (Dec–Feb) is cold with regular snowfall.

santa-ana.destination_info: Santa Ana is a year-round destination. It’s typically warm and dry Jun–Oct, with mild weather the rest of the year. Winters (Dec–Feb) see the highest chance of rainfall. The annual Cinco de Mayo Festival (May) draws large crowds with colorful parades, carnival rides, food vendors and live music.

new-orleans.destination_info: New Orleans' peak travel season is Feb–May, which is also when major events like Mardi Gras (Feb/Mar) and Jazz Fest (Apr–May) occur. Other events are the Essence Music Festival (Jul), which focuses on African-American artists; Tales of the Cocktail (Jul), with mixology-related events; the Louis Armstrong celebration Satchmo Summerfest (Aug); the New Orleans Film Festival (Oct); and the Voodoo music festival (Oct/Nov). Summers can be hot, humid and rainy. Hurricane season is Jun–Nov.

raleigh.destination_info: Raleigh’s relatively moderate temperatures make it a year-round destination. Summers (Jun–Aug) are generally hot and humid. The North Carolina State Fair (Oct) offers rides, music and a flower and garden show. Winters (Dec–Feb) bring colder temperatures with the possibility of snow and sleet.

columbus.destination_info: Columbus is a year-round destination with a temperate climate. The Columbus Winter Beerfest (Jan) features more than 100 breweries. Artists from around the country exhibit their work on the Scioto Mile for the Columbus Arts Festival (Jun). The Columbus Pride Festival (Jun) includes a downtown parade, live music and vendors. The Ohio State Fair (Jul–Aug) offers agricultural exhibitions, live music and rides.

san-antonio.destination_info: San Antonio has mild winters (Dec–Feb), and hot and humid summers (Jun–Sep). Summer, as well as warm spring (Mar–May) are the most popular times to visit. Remember the Alamo Weekend (Mar) sees reenactments of the battle. Fiesta San Antonio (Apr), a long-standing heritage festival, is a huge, 11-day party known for its flower parades, live music and food stands.

ontario.destination_info: Ontario is a year-round destination, with mild to warm weather for much of the year. Summers (Jun–Aug) tend to be hot, while winters (Dec–Feb) are typically mild. There is a slightly higher chance of rain Jan–Apr. The Road to California (Jan) is a quilt show featuring quilting competitions, classes and exhibits. The city celebrates Independence Day (Jul 4) with a parade, picnic and fireworks display. The Route 66 Cruisin' Reunion (Sep) attracts vintage cars from around the country.

cincinnati.destination_info: Apr–Sep is a popular time to visit, peaking at the height of the hot summer (Jul–Aug). Temperatures can dip below freezing in winter (Dec–Feb). Big-name jazz, R&B and soul artists headline the Cincinnati Music Festival (Jul). Riverfest (Sep) features a fireworks display, along with live music and food stalls.

jacksonville.destination_info: Jacksonville is mild to warm most of the year, with hot and humid summers (Jun–Aug). Popular times to visit include Mar–Jul and Nov–Dec. The Jacksonville Jazz Festival (May) features free concerts by prominent international jazz artists in various indoor and outdoor venues.

anchorage.destination_info: Most visitors arrive in summer (Jun–Aug), when the weather is mild and dry. Winters (Oct–Apr) are cold and snowy. Local events include the Anchorage Folk Festival (Jan), Fur Rendezvous winter festival (Feb–Mar) and the Iditarod Trail Sled Dog Race (Mar), which runs from Anchorage to Nome.
